notes:
Areas and projects, Settings panes, and delete a spec.

- Areas: group your repos into colored areas in the sidebar. Click a header to fold it, Option-click to fold the others. A folded area shows how many of its specs need you. Drag repos into and between areas, and drag areas to reorder them. Make, rename, color and delete areas from the context menu.
- When a repo joins, Spec Studio can suggest an area with the same GitHub owner, the same parent folder or shared specs. On the first launch, it offers to make areas from your GitHub owners. Spec Studio never moves a repo by itself.
- Projects: a goal with specs across repos, a status, a target date, milestones, "waits for" relations and project updates. The Projects section and the project view show the progress. Claude writes updates with studio project update.
- The New Spec sheet takes a project and lists the area's other repos first. The Priority panel can show one area. Notifications name the area of their spec.
- studio project new|list|show|add|remove|status|milestone|wait|update, and --area and --project on studio specs.
- Delete a spec in the app or with studio delete. A deleted spec also leaves its project.
- Settings has General, Appearance and Remote Relay panes, and a Backend pane for a backend plugin. The Shipped panel's repo sections fold.
- Sessions clean and push their own files without a permission prompt (studio scratch, studio clean).
- list_projects and the area filters in Claude AI need relay 0.6.0.

Messages to each repo's desk, relay threads that stay current, and merges that Spec Studio does not miss.

- Claude AI can message the desk of a repo through the relay, as it messages a spec. Turn it on per repo in Settings, Remote Relay ("Claude AI can message this desk"). It is off by default.
- When you answer in a spec's terminal after a message from Claude AI, your answer also goes into the relay thread, so Claude AI sees that the spec does not still wait.
- A PR that merges on GitHub now always moves its spec out of Merge. A stuck gh call no longer stops the PR checks, a failed check shows "cannot read" in the status strip with the reason, and the new command studio pr refresh checks a spec's PRs at once.
- Desk messages and local answers need relay 0.5.0. Older relays from 0.3.0 still work for everything else.

Repos inside other repos update again.

- When one repo in the sidebar is inside another (for example ~/code and ~/code/tool), a change in the inner repo now updates its own specs. Before, the app updated the outer repo, and the inner repo's specs showed an old stage and old text until the app restarted.

Messages from Claude AI, a matching app and relay, and a themed Settings window.

- Messages from Claude AI go into a session whenever Claude is idle, also while an autopilot spec works.
- New command studio inbox: a session reads its new messages and marks them read. studio message --reply-to marks the message it answers.
- The app and the agent stay in sync, and Settings tells you when the app and the relay do not match.
- Works with the pluggable relay store in relay 0.4.0.
- Settings, the Changes repo tabs and the New Spec mode tabs use the app's own look, not the macOS controls.
- The site has how-to guides and a demo video.
- Needs relay 0.3.0 or later.

Lighter relay sync.

- The relay sync sends one frame per spec per drain, with all its new lines, so a long spec no longer makes hundreds of relay updates.
- A spec's first sync sends only its last 20 activity lines and its messages.
- The state goes to the relay only when it changed.
- Needs relay 0.3.0 or later: Settings says when the relay is too old.
- The app gets the login PATH, so the PR poll finds gh.

First release of Spec Studio.

- Run a spec through five stages with one Claude session: Spec, Plan, Build, Check and Merge.
- Autopilot takes a description to reviewed draft PRs with one approval at the end. Guided mode asks at each gate.
- Loop mode: one ask, one change, its proof.
- The self review runs parallel finders and a 2-of-3 verifier vote on each PR.
- A shell panel beside each session, themes, and a Settings window.
- The remote relay (self-hosted, in spec-studio-app/relay) lets Claude AI read specs and send messages while the Mac is offline.
